run_pipeline_consisid: run the ConsisIDPipeline to generate a video from an input image and text prompt with face identity conditioning
encode_prompt_consisid: encode a text prompt into T5 hidden state embeddings for the ConsisID video generation pipeline
prepare_latents_consisid: prepare video latents from an input image with optional keypoints conditioning for ConsisID generation
decode_latents_consisid: decode video latents back to pixel-space frames using the VAE decoder in ConsisIDPipeline
draw_kps_consisid: draw keypoints and connecting limbs on a PIL image for facial keypoint visualization in ConsisID
